stats.notes: Found one confirmed bug: spikes subtract 500 points from a score of 100 and the score wraps to 65136 (unsigned 16-bit underflow) instead of flooring at 0. Reproduced in run 2 and run 3 (seed 1, 4 tokens). The 4-token path is the shortest possible because spikes at (3,3) are 4 Manhattan steps from the start. Budget is nearly spent, so I stopped here without exploring further mechanics (dash, pause, doors, enemies, gates, timer, dialogs).
